requirement.description: Memory.init immutability checking has incorrect error messages that don't match test expectations. Tests expect specific error message formats for various operations on Memory.init.
requirement.contract: Memory.init should raise TypeError with specific error messages when trying to set invalid values or perform unsupported operations like deletion or insertion. The error messages must match exactly what tests expect, including proper formatting of value representations.

requirement.description: Signal and Format classes lack proper __repr__ methods, resulting in poor debug output and test failures for value representation.
requirement.contract: All representation classes (Signal, Repr, Format subclasses) must have consistent __repr__ methods that produce predictable string representations matching test expectations. Signal.__repr__ should return "(sig)" for unnamed signals.

requirement.description: Switch constructor fails when cases parameter is provided as a list of tuples instead of a dictionary, causing AttributeError when trying to call .items() on a list.
requirement.contract: Switch constructor must accept both dictionary and list/tuple formats for cases parameter, converting list format to dictionary internally to prevent AttributeError.
